The '''Muntuur system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] that was located within the [[Sloo sector/Legends|Sloo sector]], a part of the [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] regions known as the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]]<ref name="EAOC" /> and [[The Slice/Legends|the Slice]].<ref name="Slice" /> It was the origin point of the [[Muntuur stones]], a well-known grouping of seven stones each weighing at least five [[Metric ton/Legends|metric tons]].<ref name="CSWE">{{CSWECite|II|343|Muntuur stones}}</ref><ref name="Planetnamia">{{Planetnamia|other=the [[Muntuur stones]]|system=Muntuur [[Star system/Legends|system]]|legends=1}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Muntuur system was established in the [[StarWars.com]] [[Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion|Online Companion]] to the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', which placed the system in grid square P-14.<ref name="EAOC" />
